lesson.name: Learn The Sicilian Rossolimo And Moscow Variations
lesson.description: 3. Bb5 is a popular move against the Sicilian, leading to the Rossolimo and Moscow Variations, depending on Black's second move.

{What strong idea did Magnus Carlsen find to improve the scope of his knight?}

useful Ng6 move. White already has to be careful to hold the balance.} (14...
Nd7 $2 15. Nf3 {White has the more active position and Black faces an uphill
struggle. Try again and look for a way to clear a good square for your knight.}

block the white bishop.}) (14... Bd7 $2 15. d4 {Black doesn't want to
undevelop. Try again and look for a better way to activate your knight.}) (
14... Bc8 15. Raf1 {Black doesn't want to undevelop. Try again and look for a

{How should White justify the strange position of the bishop on d3?} 7. c3 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to make a useful

retreat square available for the bishop on the b1-h7 diagonal. How should you
do it?}) (7. a4 $5 {This is OK, but it's better to make a retreat square
available for the bishop on the b1-h7 diagonal. How should you do it?}) (7. h3

bishop on the b1-h7 diagonal. How should you do it?}) (7. c4 $2 Ne5 {There's a

for th bishop to stay on the b1-h7 diagonal. Where should it go?}) (8. Qe2 $5 {
This is OK, but it's better to retreat your bishop. Where should it go?}) (8.
Be2 $2 Nxe4 {Black wins a pawn. Try again and look for a better bishop move.})
(8. Bc4 $2 b5 {The bishop is vulnerable on c4. Try to find a better square for
it.}) 8... b5 {Now White's ready to conquer the center. How should you do it?}
9. d4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a way to occupy
the center.] [%hint Create a strong two-pawn center.] Well done! White has a
big center and good chances for an advantage.} (9. Qe2 $5 {This is OK, but
it's better to occupy the center. How should you do it?}) *
